limitations: The original frozen audit contains known parser false negatives and must be disclosed with its labelled supplement. Its verified-exposure count of zero must not be described as zero actual memory delivery.
Literal source injection and source-file equality are not equivalent to complete pre-verifier provenance, useful memory, or causal performance benefit. The missing ID association remains unknown.
Known token/dollar subtotals are not complete totals. No missing call was zero-imputed, dropped, reconciled or replaced.
Twelve previously exposed task identities in three small Python projects and repeated seeds are not new independent held-out evidence. Historical negative rounds remain separate.

This checks source-bound files, recorded lifecycle data and external-grade artifacts; it is not an arbitrary-hostile-host attestation. No new sandbox execution, build, live API or model interaction was used.
